items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well say a funeral like Buddy Petit's funeral, who would play that? [INTERVIEWEE] I had a get together band, and Eureka played two bands. Louis Armstrong was part there.

ctx.x: I never did get that much. No.
Well say a funeral like Buddy Petit's funeral, who would play that?
I had a get together band, and Eureka played two bands. Louis Armstrong was part there. That's the time he was here at the Suburban Garden.
